suppress.reason: Help pages link with the dashboard's in-app routing schemes (help:<id> and /?tab=docsTab&doc=<id>), which are resolved at render time by dashboard/help_manual.py and dashboard/docs_catalog.py — not by the filesystem. Atlas reads them as relative paths. Those ids ARE validated, against HELP_TREE and DOC_MODULES; that check currently reports zero broken references.
Links the architecture diagrams via /help?topic=… because 13-architecture-diagrams.md is a Help page, not a Docs-catalog entry — a relative link would 404 in the Docs reader. Verified 200.
Same /help?topic=… app route as ARCHITECTURE.md, for the same reason.

Claude Code SKILL.md and agent files are defined by YAML frontmatter (name, description); an H1 is not part of that format and the six-key frontmatter rule is enforced by tools/claude-plugin/bin/validate-skills. These are agent instruction files, not corpus documents.
The GitHub Pages landing page intentionally carries the project name, the same title as README.md. Jekyll builds the public site from it; they are the same document for two audiences.
Paired with index.md by design: index.md is the GitHub Pages landing page Jekyll builds from the same project identity. H3 files a finding against both halves of a pair, so both paths are named here.
